hero.text: Welcome to Umang Vision Academy, your complete AI-powered learning platform designed for students from Classes 9 to 12, Graduation, and Competitive Exams. Learn with expert instructors, interactive courses, AI tutors, live classes, quizzes, assignments, and personalized learning paths that help every student achieve academic excellence.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using Umang Vision Academy, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the platform.

accounts.title: 2. User Accounts
accounts.body: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account credentials. Any activity performed under your account is your responsibility.

courseAccess.title: 3. Course Access
courseAccess.body: Purchased or enrolled courses are intended solely for personal, non-commercial use. Sharing account credentials or course content is prohibited.

instructorResponsibilities.title: 4. Instructor Responsibilities
instructorResponsibilities.body: Instructors must provide accurate information during the application process and ensure that uploaded content does not violate intellectual property rights.

payments.title: 5. Payments & Refunds
payments.body: Payments for courses and subscriptions are processed securely. Refund eligibility is subject to the platform's refund policy.

prohibitedConduct.title: 6. Prohibited Conduct
prohibitedConduct.item2: Attempting to gain unauthorized access to the platform.
prohibitedConduct.item3: Harassing, threatening, or abusing other users.
prohibitedConduct.item4: Uploading malicious software or harmful content.

accountTermination.title: 7. Account Termination
accountTermination.body: Umang Vision Academy reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms of Service.

changes.title: 8. Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms periodically. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of any revisions.

contact.title: 9. Contact Information
contact.body: For questions regarding these Terms, contact us at support@umangacademy.com.

information.title: 1. Information We Collect
information.body: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, account details, and course activity.

dataProtection.title: 3. Data Protection
dataProtection.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access or disclosure.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.body: Umang Vision Academy may use cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience, analyze traffic, and improve functionality.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: We may use trusted third-party providers for authentication, analytics, hosting, and payment processing.

userRights.title: 6. User Rights
userRights.body: Users may request access, correction, or deletion of their personal information, subject to applicable laws.

childrensPrivacy.title: 7. Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.body: Umang Vision Academy is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: 8. Changes to Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page.

contact.title: 9. Contact Us
contact.body: For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@umangvisionacademy.com.

hero.description: Umang Vision Academy started in a small room in Jabalpur with one goal: give every Indian student — regardless of their city, school, or income — access to world-class education. That mission hasn't changed.

mission.heading: Democratise quality education across India
mission.description: Over 260 million students study in Indian schools. Less than 5% have access to quality coaching. We're using AI, live classes, and personalised learning paths to close that gap — one student at a time.

curiosity.title: Curiosity-led learning
curiosity.desc: We design experiences that encourage questions, experiments, and deeper understanding.

trust.title: Trust through transparency
trust.desc: No dark patterns. No hidden fees. Students and parents always know what they're paying for and why.

access.title: Access for everyone
access.desc: Quality education shouldn't depend on your pin code. We offer scholarships and low-bandwidth support.

outcomes.title: Outcomes over vanity
outcomes.desc: We measure success by student results — not app opens. If a feature doesn't improve scores, it ships last.
